build_cython_extension: run python setup.py build_ext --inplace to compile the cython_lib.graph_helper Cython extension module
build_graph_helper: build the graph_helper Cython extension from graph_helper.pyx using cythonize and numpy include dirs
review_setup_config: review the distutils setup configuration for the cython_lib package and its extension modules
refactor_extension_list: refactor the ext_modules list to add additional Cython extensions to the cython_lib package
summarize_build_deps: summarize the build dependencies including numpy and Cython required to compile the graph_helper extension
